slug: 一年抽取一词条模拟的也可以
lines: 【欢迎收看六子新书，摆碗！
跪求追读！
【新来的朋友可能还不认识我，自我介绍一下，以下截图出自我的老书：】
“大春，你敢不敢再赌一次。”
陈奕肩扛沉重的麻袋，站在码头边，看着滔滔不绝的青河河水。
他想跳河。
大春呵呵一笑。
“奕哥，老张他们说下游有吃人的妖怪哩！
黑石帮起码管饭，虽然吃不饱，嘿嘿……”
陈奕叹了一口气，看了一眼这位身材胖乎乎，双眼分头站岗的朋友。
他也想像大春一样无忧无虑。
哪怕被黑帮强抓壮丁，签卖身契，在码头做免费的力工。
但是……
我可是穿越者，还有系统，我这一生只能被困在这个破码头吗？？
眼前，一道只有陈奕能看见的提示忽隐忽现。
【距离下次抽取词条，还有00:10:03。
心念一动，系统面板浮现。
【姓名：陈奕】
【境界：无】
【功法：无】
【已装备词条（33）：三角肌发达[白]、耐饿[白]、超兽的痛觉[白]】
【已获取词条（17）：脑袋尖尖[白]、护食[白]、爱吃鸡蛋[白]……】
【当前各品质词条概率：】
【白色普通99%，绿色稀有0.9%，紫色史诗0.089%，金色传说0.01%，棱彩神话0.001%】
这就是陈奕的抽词条系统。
这个金手指有两个小问题。
第一，一年只能抽一次。
如果出货率高，抽数低也能接受。
可它的第二个问题就是出货率极低！
最低级的白色词条高达99%，严重污染牌库！
在过去的十七年，陈奕抽了十七次，全是白色！
要提升高品质词条的概率，以及装备更多词条，也不是没办法——修炼武道，提升境界！
然而，陈奕没有根骨，修炼不了武道。
得，无解了。
白色词条也不是完全没用。
比如陈奕现在装备的三个。
“三角肌发达”
让他的肩膀力量提升少许，方便扛货。
“耐饿”
能减少饿肚子的不适。
“超兽的痛觉”
content_en:
[Welcome to Liuzi’s new book, Setting the Bowl!
Begging to read!
[New friends may not know me yet, so let me introduce myself. The following screenshots are from my old book:]
"Dachun, do you dare to bet again?"
Chen Yi stood on the edge of the pier with a heavy sack on his shoulders, looking at the surging Qinghe River.
He wanted to jump into the river.
Dachun chuckled.
"Brother Yi, Lao Zhang and the others said there are man-eating monsters downstream!
At least the Blackstone Gang takes care of the food, even if they don’t have enough to eat, hehe..."
Chen Yi sighed and glanced at this chubby friend who stood guard with his eyes apart.
He also wanted to be as carefree as Dachun.
Even if he is raped by gangs, he will sign a contract to sell his body and work as a free laborer at the dock.
But...
I am a time traveler, and I still have a system. Can I only be trapped in this broken pier for the rest of my life? ?
In front of his eyes, a prompt that only Chen Yi could see flickered in and out.
[There are still 00:10:03 until the next extraction of terms.
With a thought, the system panel appeared.
[Name: Chen Yi]
[Realm: None]
[Skill: None]
[Equipped entries (33): Developed deltoid muscles [white], hunger resistance [white], super beast's pain sense [white]]
[Acquired entries (17): Pointed head [white], food protection [white], love to eat eggs [white]...]
[Current probability of each quality entry:]
[White common 99%, green rare 0.9%, purple epic 0.089%, golden legend 0.01%, prismatic myth 0.001%]
This is Chen Yi’s entry extraction system.
There are two small problems with this cheat.
First, you can only draw once a year.
If the shipment rate is high, a low draw number is acceptable.
But its second problem is that its shipment rate is extremely low!
The lowest white terms are as high as 99%, seriously polluting the card library!
In the past seventeen years, Chen Yi smoked seventeen times, all white!
There is no way to increase the probability of high-quality entries and equip more entries - practice martial arts and improve your realm!
However, Chen Yi has no bones and cannot practice martial arts.
Okay, no solution.
The white entries are not completely useless.
For example, the three currently equipped by Chen Yi.
"Developed deltoid muscles"
Let his shoulder strength increase a little to make it easier to carry goods.
“Hungry tolerant”
Can reduce the discomfort of hunger.
"Super beast's pain"
